Publish.LongDescription:
# Car Freedom
**Every resident household gets a personal car - and the car is spawned right at the household's home, so citizens always find it parked close by and actually drive instead of walking.**
# !!! WARNING - PLEASE READ BEFORE SUBSCRIBING !!!
**This mod was written with the help of AI and has NOT been extensively tested. It is provided AS IS, with absolutely no guarantee of safety, stability, compatibility or save-game integrity. You use it entirely at your own risk.**
Before you enable this mod, please make sure you understand the following:
* **BACK UP YOUR SAVE GAME FIRST.** This is a code mod that creates vehicle entities in your city. Keep a manual backup copy of any save you care about (and use a separate test city if possible) so you can always roll back. * **No warranty, no liability.** If your city breaks, your save is damaged, or the game crashes, there is no guarantee that this can be fixed and no liability is accepted. * **Not thoroughly verified.** The mod was only tested on a limited number of saves and a limited amount of gameplay. Edge cases - unusual maps, very large cities, other mods, DLC combinations - have not been covered. * **It modifies live simulation data.** Disabling the mod does not remove the cars that were already created; they stay in your save as normal vehicles. * **Always keep a backup before every game version update.** Game updates can change internal code and make the mod behave unexpectedly or stop working. * **No support is promised.** Feedback and bug reports are welcome, but fixes are not guaranteed.
**If any of the above is not acceptable to you, please do not subscribe to or use this mod.**
## What it does
Tired of households that own no car at all, or that park their cars so far away that citizens give up driving and walk instead?
This mod makes sure almost every **resident household owns at least one personal car**, and spawns it **right at the household's home building**. Because the car starts next to the home, it is always parked close by - so citizens genuinely pick it up when they travel.
## Settings
The mod adds its own page under **Options > Mods > Car Freedom**:
* **Minimum household members** - a slider from 1 to 20, default 3. Households with fewer members than this are skipped entirely: they are not counted as carless and no vehicle is spawned for them. The default of 3 still covers the typical family; set it to 1 if you want every household to receive a car (the behaviour of earlier versions).
Changes take effect on the next simulation pass - no reload and no restart needed. Cars that were already granted are never removed, even if you raise the threshold.
## How it works
* Periodically scans every resident household that has a home. * If the household owns no personal car, it is granted one. * The car is created with the exact same internal call the vanilla game uses when a household buys a car (PersonalCarSelectData.CreateVehicle). The only difference is that the "dealership" is the household's own home, so the car always starts nearby. * Ownership, parking, driving and path-finding all use the vanilla systems, which keeps the mod compatible with other traffic / AI mods. * Households that already own a car are skipped - no duplicates. * Tourists, commuters, homeless households and households that are moving away are ignored.
## Technical notes
* Works on existing saves. Newly added cars are spread over time (at most 32 per tick), so a large city fills up gradually over a few game days. * Cars are granted for free - the vanilla purchase probability and price are left untouched. * Built entirely on the game's own ECS pipeline; no game files are modified. * The scan reads households directly from the game's ECS chunks and is written to be cheap: in a city of 200,000 citizens it costs a fraction of a millisecond per pass, and the pass is skipped entirely when every household already has a car. * The mod is currently English/Chinese only in its log output; it adds no UI of its own.
## 中文说明
**让绝大多数居民家庭都拥有至少一辆私家车，并且车辆直接生成在自家门口**，因此永远停在离家最近的位置——市民出门时就会真正选择开车，而不是因为车位太远而改走路。
# ！！！重要警告 - 订阅前请务必阅读！！！
**本模组由 AI 生成，未经充分测试，按"现状"提供，不提供任何形式的安全、稳定性、兼容性或存档完整性的保障。使用风险完全由你自己承担。**
* **请务必先备份存档。** 这是一个会向城市中生成车辆实体的代码模组。请手动备份你在意的存档（最好另开一个测试城市），以便随时回退。 * **不提供任何担保。** 如果城市异常、存档损坏或游戏崩溃，不保证能够修复，也不承担任何责任。 * **未经充分验证。** 仅在有限的存档和有限的游戏时长中测试过；特殊地图、超大人口城市、其他模组组合、DLC 组合等情况均未覆盖。 * **它会修改进行中的模拟数据。** 关闭模组并不会移除已经生成的车辆，它们会作为普通车辆留在存档中。 * **每次游戏版本更新前请先备份。** 游戏更新可能改变内部代码，导致模组行为异常或失效。 * **不承诺提供支持。** 欢迎反馈问题，但不保证会修复。
**如果你无法接受以上任何一点，请不要订阅或使用本模组。**
## 设置界面
模组在 **游戏设置 → 模组 → Car Freedom** 中提供独立设置页：
* **家庭最少成员数** —— 滑动条，范围 1 到 20，默认 3。成员数低于该值的家庭会被完全跳过：不计入无车统计，也不会为其生成车辆。默认值 3 仍能覆盖典型家庭；如果你希望所有家庭都获得车辆（旧版本的行为），把它设为 1。
改动在下一轮模拟扫描时生效，无需重新读档或重启游戏。即使调高阈值，已经发出去的车辆也不会被收回。
## 工作原理
* 定期扫描每一户有房屋的居民家庭。 * 如果家庭没有私家车，就为其配一辆。 * 车辆的创建调用与原版购车完全相同（PersonalCarSelectData.CreateVehicle）。唯一区别是"经销商"变成了家庭自己的住宅，所以车总是从家附近开始。 * 所有权、停车、驾驶和寻路全部沿用原版系统，因此与其他交通 / AI 类模组兼容。 * 已有车的家庭会被跳过，不会重复发车。 * 游客、通勤者、无家可归家庭以及正在搬离的家庭会被忽略。
## 技术说明
* 对已有存档生效。新增车辆分布在时间上（每刻最多 32 辆），人口多的城市会在数个游戏日内逐步完成覆盖。 * 发车是免费的，原版的购车概率与价格逻辑保持不变。 * 完全基于游戏自身的 ECS 流水线构建，不修改任何游戏文件。 * 扫描直接读取游戏 ECS 的 chunk 数据，开销很低：20 万人口的城市每轮只占用零点几毫秒；当所有家庭都已拥有车辆时会整体跳过。 * 模组没有自己的界面，仅在日志中输出英文/中文信息。
